projectName: White tiger plush restuff and new eyes
title: White tiger plush restuffed, with new lidded eyes and mended whiskers
description: This white tiger plush was deep cleaned and restuffed, and both of his eyes were replaced with matching eyes that have eyelids. His whiskers were repaired and the stitching on his paws was touched up.
itemDetails: This is a large lying white tiger plush with cream sherpa fur, grey stripes, a pink nose and a long striped tail. His eyes have small moulded eyelids, which give him a sleepy, gentle look.
repairDetails: This tiger was given a deep clean, then his old stuffing was removed and replaced with fresh fill. Both of his eyes were replaced. His original eyes had eyelids, so it took some work to source new eyes in the same colour with the same eyelid shape. For some smaller fixes, his whiskers were repaired and the stitching on his paws was touched up.
